dialog.english:
Hey, Joe! What kind of gifts do
you like?
Where'd that come from?

Well, I wanted to get the Marching
Fishes a present, 'cause they're
always helping me out.
dialog.translation:
Es que quería hacerles un
regalo a los Marching Fishes,
que siempre me ayudan.

dialog.english:
The Marching... you mean those
little fish?

Yeah, yeah! I wanted to show my
gratitude and get them a present!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí, sí! ¡Quería darles las
gracias con un regalo!

dialog.english:
Hm, I'm not sure if I'm the one
you should be asking about this.
dialog.translation:
Mmm, no sé si soy el más
indicado para esto.

dialog.english:
Okay, then if you can't come up 
with anything better, why don't we
go find some DigiClams?
dialog.translation:
Vale, pues si no se te ocurre
nada mejor, ¿por qué no
buscamos DigiAlmejas?

dialog.english:
There's such a thing as
"DigiClams"? Do they live near the
ocean, like normal clams?
dialog.translation:
¿Existen las "DigiAlmejas"?
¿Viven en el mar, como las
almejas normales?

dialog.english:
DigiClams should be at sandy
beaches! Okay, Joe! Let's go to
the beach!
dialog.translation:
¡Las DigiAlmejas están en las
playas de arena! ¡Vamos, Joe!
¡A la playa!

dialog.english: Huh? Right now?

Hey, Joe! We're gonna get going
soon!

Ah, Tai! Sorry, but can we go
to the beach now?
dialog.translation:
¡Ah, Tai! Perdona, ¿pero
podemos ir a la playa?

dialog.english:
What? We don't have time to go
sunbathing!
dialog.translation:
¿Qué? ¡No tenemos tiempo para
tomar el sol!

dialog.english:
No, we have to! Gomamon's honor
depends on this passionate,
heartfelt gift! As does mine!
dialog.translation:
¡Tenemos que ir! ¡El honor de
Gomamon depende de este
regalo! ¡Y el mío también!

dialog.english: I don't get it, but whatever...
Yaaaaay! Joe, thank you!
We finally made it.

I wonder if any more Digimon are
gonna attack us...
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si nos atacarán
más Digimon...

dialog.english:
It's okay, we won't stick around
for long! Let's find as many
DigiClams as we can!
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquila, no nos quedaremos
mucho! ¡Busquemos todas las
DigiAlmejas que podamos!

dialog.english: Matt, I challenge you!
Sounds fun. Bring it on!

Is it really okay to be taking all
these DigiClams?
dialog.translation:
¿Seguro que está bien llevarnos
tantas DigiAlmejas?

dialog.english:
Sure! Why don't we take about five
million?
F-f-five million?

Hahaha, I'm kidding. You can't
take a joke at all!
dialog.translation:
Jajaja, es broma. ¡No sabes
aguantar una broma!

dialog.english:
We're all working together, so I
think you'll only need to get
around five or so!
dialog.translation:
¡Estamos todos juntos en esto,
así que con cinco o así
bastará!

dialog.english: Whew! Are these all the DigiClams?
That's it! Thanks so much, Joe!
We really found a lot, didn't we?

Yep! I bet the Marching Fishes
will be happy, too!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Seguro que los Marching
Fishes se alegran!

dialog.english:
What's going on? Are Tai and
Matt fighting? Let's check it
out.
dialog.translation:
¿Qué pasa? ¿Se están peleando
Tai y Matt? Vamos a ver.

dialog.english: My DigiClams are bigger!

It's not the size that matters,
it's the number you caught!
dialog.translation:
¡No importa el tamaño, sino
cuántas has cogido!

dialog.english: Size!
Number!

Stop! Let's not get ahead of
ourselves!
Okay, let's have Joe decide!

There's no other way to settle
this!
dialog.translation:
¡No hay otra forma de
resolver esto!

dialog.english:
Whoever found the biggest
DigiClams is the winner, right?
dialog.translation:
Gana quien tenga las
DigiAlmejas más grandes, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Joe! Shouldn't the winner be the
one who gathered more?
Um...
Tai's the winner!
Matt's the winner!
It's a tie!
All right!
No way...
See?
Whaaaaat?!
That can't be right.
Hmmmm...

(Both of them look
disappointed...)
Wait! Something's coming!
Ah!

There *were* Digimon here after
all!

They came because they smelled the
DigiClams!
Let's fight for 'em!

Whew. We managed to fight them
off... Hey, Gomamon, look at all
the DigiClams we gathered!
dialog.translation:
Uf. Conseguimos ahuyentarlos...
¡Oye, Gomamon, mira todas las
DigiAlmejas que reunimos!

dialog.english:
Thank you, Joe! Guys! I bet the
Marching Fishes will be really
happy!
dialog.translation:
¡Gracias, Joe! ¡Chicos! ¡Seguro
que los Marching Fishes se
alegran!

dialog.english:
...Joe and Gomamon's happy faces
make me feel kinda stupid for
getting into that fight.
dialog.translation:
...Ver felices a Joe y Gomamon
me hace sentir tonto por
haberme peleado.

dialog.english: It was my fault! I'm sorry.
My bad too. I'm sorry.

Joe, you said that they tied
because you didn't want them to
fight, didn't you?
dialog.translation:
Joe, dijiste que empataron
porque no querías que
pelearan, ¿verdad?

dialog.english:
Hm? Well, yeah, that's basically
it.
dialog.translation:
¿Eh? Bueno, sí, más o menos
es eso.

dialog.english: You're amazing, Joe!

You can only get DigiClams at
sandy beaches!
dialog.translation:
¡Solo hay DigiAlmejas en
playas de arena!

dialog.english: Joe!
What's up, T.K?

I found this while we were looking
for DigiClams. I'll let you have
it, Joe.
dialog.translation:
Encontré esto buscando
DigiAlmejas. Te lo doy a
ti, Joe.

dialog.english:
I found this. I'll let you have
it, Joe.
dialog.translation:
Encontré esto. Te lo doy
a ti, Joe.

dialog.english: Ah, thank you so much!

No problem, it's my thanks to you
for stopping that fight!
dialog.translation:
¡De nada, es mi forma de
agradecerte que pararas la
pelea!

dialog.english: Obtained a DigiClam!
Hey, Joe, how's Matt doing?
I mean, I'm just curious!

We're in a contest, after all.
Asking for help is basically
cheating.
dialog.translation:
Al fin y al cabo, es una
competición. Pedir ayuda es
casi trampa.

dialog.english:
I'll win, I'll definitely win...
*mumble*
dialog.translation:
Voy a ganar, seguro que
gano... (murmura)

dialog.english:
Nice job, Matt! What amazing
concentration!

I mean, I know it's a thank-you
gift, but I've never heard of
DigiClams...
dialog.translation:
Sé que es un regalo, pero
nunca oí hablar de las
DigiAlmejas...

dialog.english:
We really aren't in Japan after
all, huh.
dialog.translation:
Desde luego, esto no es
Japón, eh.

dialog.english:
The sea breeze is bad for
precision machinery...
dialog.translation:
La brisa marina es mala
para mi maquinaria...

dialog.english:
Why didn't you leave your computer
behind?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué no dejaste el
ordenador en casa?

dialog.english:
I'm worried it'll break if I'm not
watching it...
dialog.translation:
Me preocupa que se rompa si
no lo vigilo...

dialog.english: The sea breeze feels so good...
dialog.translation: Qué gusto da la brisa marina...

dialog.english:
Looks like someone's having fun,
unlike a certain someone who likes
to get all high and mighty.
dialog.translation:
Parece que alguien se lo
pasa bien, a diferencia de
cierta persona tan sabionda.

dialog.english: Hey! I'm doing my best, you know!

T.Kuu! Look, look, it's a
DigiStarfish!
Whoaaaaa! Wow!
Whoaaaaa! Wow!
Whoaaaaa! Wow!

Those two are totally fixated by
the seashore. Are they even
looking for DigiClams?
dialog.translation:
Esos dos están fascinados
con la orilla. ¿Están
buscando DigiAlmejas o qué?

dialog.english: Seriously!

Hey, Joe. Why is ocean water
salty?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Joe. ¿Por qué el mar
es salado?

dialog.english: Because of the salt flow from land.
dialog.translation: Por la sal que viene de tierra.

dialog.english: Because the ocean contains salt.

It's because salt flows into the
sea from the land!
dialog.translation:
¡Es porque la sal llega al
mar desde la tierra!

dialog.english:
Then how come river water isn't
all that salty?
dialog.translation:
¿Entonces por qué el río no
es tan salado?

dialog.english:
Now that you mention it, you might
be right...
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo dices, puede
que tengas razón...

dialog.english: Come on, Joe...

It's because the ocean contains
dissolved salt.
dialog.translation:
Es porque el mar contiene
sal disuelta.

dialog.english:
But what about rain and river
water flowing in? Wouldn't that
dilute it?
dialog.translation:
¿Pero y la lluvia y los ríos
que desembocan? ¿No lo
diluiría eso?

dialog.english:
True, but moisture evaporates from 
the ocean's surface. If you're
curious, I'll lend you my book.
dialog.translation:
Cierto, el agua se evapora
del mar. Si tienes curiosidad,
te presto el libro.

dialog.english: Thanks! I'll check it out!

I've never heard of DigiClams
before...
dialog.translation:
Nunca oí hablar de las
DigiAlmejas...

dialog.english:
Me too. I wonder if they're like
normal clams?
dialog.translation:
Yo tampoco. ¿Serán como las
almejas normales?

dialog.english: What do clams look like?
Try to answer it yourself
Ask an expert

They're shellfish with two sides,
and they have a zigzag pattern.
dialog.translation:
Son mariscos con dos
valvas, con un patrón en
zigzag.

dialog.english: Aren't those scallops?

Huh? I was so sure those were
clams...
You're pretty unreliable...
Let's ask Gomamon.

So there are things even you don't
know...
dialog.translation:
Así que hay cosas que ni
tú sabes...

dialog.english:
It's better to get a definitive
answer from an expert than to rely
on incomplete knowledge.
dialog.translation:
Es mejor una respuesta clara
de un experto que fiarse de un
conocimiento a medias.

dialog.english: So that's how you think!

Hey, Mimi, why aren't you looking
for DigiClams too?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Mimi, ¿por qué no
buscas tú también
DigiAlmejas?

dialog.english:
I refuse! If I do that, I'll get
dirty!
Then you can't have dinner today!
I'll reward you if you help out.

If you don't help out, I won't let
you have anything to eat!
dialog.translation:
¡Si no ayudas, no te dejaré
comer nada!

dialog.english:
Huh? I'm the one in charge of
dinner today.
dialog.translation:
¿Eh? Hoy me toca a mí
preparar la cena.

dialog.english:
So *you* won't get any dinner,
Joe!

N-no way. I'm sorry... please
forget about this whole "going
without dinner" thing...
dialog.translation:
N-no puede ser. Lo siento...
olvida todo esto de
"quedarse sin cenar"...

dialog.english: Heehee!
Huh, a reward?

I'll give you some fruit that I
picked up on the way here.
dialog.translation:
Te daré fruta que recogí
de camino hasta aquí.

dialog.english: Fruit, huh? Not a bad offer, Joe!
But you *have* to help out.
Okaaaaay!
Okay, only four left!
Only three left, Joe!

Only two left! I'm getting the
hang of it!
dialog.translation:
¡Quedan dos! ¡Ya le voy
pillando el truco!

dialog.english:
Only one left! Hold out for just a
bit longer, Joe!
dialog.translation:
¡Solo queda una! ¡Aguanta un
poco más, Joe!
